title: Chapter 6873: Ocean Conch

Chapter 6873: Ocean Conch

Chapter 6873: Ocean Conch

Bear Immortal endured an onslaught from various immortals and the fortress. His eight variations’ stagnation effect collapsed after the eighth.

“Boom!” He couldn’t move his saber to block in time, resulting in a grievous hit on his chest. He spat out blood afterward.

“Bam!” The slight distraction allowed the fortress’ beam to shoot through his chest. The golden bull and giant immediately rushed forward.

Big-foot Immortal’s armored treasure also reached its highest potential, boosting his speed dramatically and rendering evasion impossible. He struck the bear’s head, nearly crushing it.

“Activate!” Bear, realizing his predicament, swung his primordial banner.

This supreme immortal artifact changed everything. The banner wrapped around him and created infinite worlds. It felt as if the banner could contain Heavenrealm itself. Thus, none of the attacks could reach him.

“Primordial Burst!” He roared, ordering a blinding eruption. The closest combatant, Big-foot Immortal, was the closest was sent flying.

The golden bull, giant, and fortress were reduced to ashes. However, they were only summons of an immortal - a great conch with beautiful runes.

Anyone would consider it to be the most beautiful conch in existence. It absorbed space and exuded an immortal light with images of figures and souls.

Unfortunately, it couldn’t absorb the primordial eruption and was also sent flying.

“So you’re behind this, Celestial Southconch.” Bear shouted.

“One of three immortals from Devouring Abyss.” Ironleaf inside Golden Lamp blurted, having knowledge of immortals in Stygian.

The abyss had surpassed Fallen Ten at this point. It had Immortal Devourer, a golden immortal, and three more grand immortals.

The conch was unique in that through his horn, he could imprison and summon dead souls to battle. The bear was fortunate to have the banner. Otherwise, the conch could have taken him down even if he had beaten Big-foot Immortal.

Killing the conch bordered on impossibility. It could summon numerous souls and wear someone down.

“A natural primordial legacy!” Big-foot shouted in astonishment.

The conch couldn’t avert its gaze from the banner. Primordial immortals already had a legacy so they didn’t desire it as much.

However, grand and golden immortals couldn’t resist the temptation. Only a few natural ones were known in Heavenrealm.

“Fellow Daoist, where did you get this?” Big-foot asked.

“A gift from my master.” Bear didn’t bother hiding it.

The two’s first reaction was that this was a lie. How many immortals could give a natural primordial legacy away like this?

“Where are you from, Fellow daoist?” Southconch asked, unaware of the bear’s true roots.

“The six continents.” Bear answered honestly again.

The two exchanged glances immediately.
